title: REQUEST FOR TECHNOCOMMERCIAL PROPOSAL FROM PROSPECTIVE BIDDERS FOR Supply, Installation, Integration, Testing and Commissioning of NavIC based Monitoring system for deep sea Buoys deployed by DGLL in the Indian Ocean Region under Atmanirbhar Bharat, Make in India Initiative.
summary: DGLL headquarters request for techno-commercial proposals and budgetary quotes for a NavIC and satellite based real-time position and health monitoring system for its deep-sea channel marking buoys off Gujarat (and one in Andaman & Nicobar), with a central monitoring centre; only EOI respondents may bid in the later GeM tender.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships, A-13 Deep Bhavan, Sector-24, Noida

sites.name: Gulf of Kutch (Salaya Channel) buoys: Mithapur, Gurur, Chandri, Kachchh, Paga, VLCC, New North Cardinal, Dhani, Tilburn, Narara, Ranwara
Gulf of Khambat (Narmada Channel) buoys 1-9 and Sultanpur
Buoy near Invisible Bank, Andaman & Nicobar Islands
Central monitoring station at Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Jamnagar / DGLL Noida or location designated by DGLL
sites.work: Monitoring centre with server, software and display

scope.item: Light sensor with integration board (02 digital + 02 analog in, 02 digital + 02 analog out)
Spares, 01 set for each of the gulfs

money.notes: Budgetary quote requested in prescribed format; all costs inclusive of GST, customs duty and freight to DGLL-designated locations.

period.warranty: 5 years for whole system, with quarterly inspections; spares/repair backup for at least 5 years after acceptance

eligibility: Prospective bidders of repute with exposure to the subject work
Only firms submitting the EOI will be allowed to participate in the subsequent GeM bid
Details of legal status, works executed in last seven years and annual turnover of last three years (Appendix 1 and 2)
Service centre/maintenance office in at least two locations
specs: Existing buoys: BS-58 mild steel, 3.6 m dia, 6 m above water, 12V/100AH SMF battery, 2 x 40 W solar panels, SL 125 tier1 LED lantern
GNSS receiver: IRNSS/NavIC, GPS, GLONASS; 200+ channels; normal (4 reports daily), emergency and instant modes; marine hardened; uses buoy power
Messages: live position on chart, light status, battery status, tsunami alert by quick height change, drift beyond radius, human interference alert
Monitoring centre: data server, access computer, minimum 36 inch display, 30 min UPS, rack; web-browser software with track history, zoom, alarms, one-year data log, daily e-mail report
Environment: indoor 0-55 C, 95% RH; outdoor 0-55 C, 100% RH, wind to 100 km/h; voltage +/-20%, frequency +/-5%
Compatible with future IMO/IALA/RTCM e-Navigation standards; replacement of defective system within 7 days; training of 06 staff for 2 days
Sample product to be ready before 10.10.2023 for demonstration at Maritime India Summit 2023
notes: Listing title is only the document heading. No reference number printed. EOI to be submitted in writing by 10:00 on 18.09.2023 to DGLL Noida (office e-mail noida-dgll@nic.in). Inconsistencies: 21 buoys listed in Gujarat plus one in A&N but hardware quantity 22; monitoring centre stated as DLL Jamnagar in one place and DGLL Noida in another; training 2 days in text but 'four days' in budget format. Buoy charted positions are given in the document.
